datasetIds.title: Apify dataset IDs with reviews
datasetIds.description: IDs of datasets produced by any review scraper (Trustpilot, G2, Capterra, TrustRadius, Walmart, Amazon, Google Maps, Mercado Libre...). Rows without review text (e.g. product rows) are skipped automatically.

jsonUrls.title: JSON URLs
jsonUrls.description: Public URLs returning a JSON array of reviews (e.g. an Apify dataset items URL).

reviews.title: Reviews (inline)
reviews.description: Reviews as strings or objects with `text` (and optional `productName`, `rating`).
prefill: Great battery life, but the camera is mediocre.
Shipping took 3 weeks. Please add a dark mode to the app!
Excellent value for money, would buy again.

llmProvider.title: AI provider
llmProvider.description: Which AI provider to use with your own API key.

apiKey.title: Your AI API key
apiKey.description: Your Gemini key (free at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey) or OpenAI key. It is stored encrypted and only used for this run. AI usage is billed by your provider, not by this actor.

model.title: Model
model.description: Leave empty for a fast, cheap default: gemini-3.1-flash-lite or gpt-4.1-mini.

outputLanguage.title: Output language
outputLanguage.description: Language for summaries, pros/cons and themes (e.g. English, Spanish, Portuguese, German). Reviews can be in any language.

groupBy.title: Group insights by
groupBy.description: One insight per product, or one for all reviews together.

perReviewSentiment.title: Output sentiment per review
perReviewSentiment.description: Also output one row per review with sentiment, score and topics.

maxReviewsPerProduct.title: Max reviews per product
maxReviewsPerProduct.description: Analyze at most this many reviews per product.

maxReviews.title: Max reviews in total
maxReviews.description: Analyze at most this many reviews in total.

batchSize.title: Reviews per AI request
batchSize.description: How many reviews go in each AI request. Larger = fewer requests.

concurrency.title: Parallel AI requests
concurrency.description: Keep 1–2 on free-tier keys to avoid rate limits (429 errors are retried automatically).
